blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Anomalies are local events, yet weakly supervised video anomaly detection scores them globally. Most methods pool an entire frame into a single vector, rank frames by that vector, and derive a location afterwards as a saliency map of the score. Full-frame pooling mixes the anomaly with its background, so a detector can reach competitive benchmark scores from scene context without being able to show where in the scene the anomaly occurs. We introduce Region-VAD, which first selects a region and then detects the anomaly from that region alone. Region-VAD selects an explicit rectangle over the tokens of a frozen foundation model and scores anomalousness only from the tokens inside the box, through attention pooling followed by a standard temporal head. The rectangle is not learned, it is the box in which the frozen tokens change most between consecutive segments, in all four feature projections of the encoder, and it is found by exhaustive search over the rectangles of the token grid. Only the pooling and the temporal head are trained, from video-level labels without boxes, masks or frame-level annotations, and no trained component reads a token outside the selected region. Experiments on five datasets, with one localizer configuration shared by all datasets and backbones, show that Region-VAD achieves state-of-the-art anomaly localization on UCF-Crime and MSAD at competitive detection performance.
blocks.zh: 异常点是局部事件, 多数方法将整个框架集合成一个单一向量,由向量排列出框架,然后得出一个位置作为分数的显著地图. 全帧集合将异常与其背景相混合,因此一个探测器可以从场景上下文达到有竞争力的基准分数,而不能显示场景中的异常发生地. 我们提出区域-VAD,它首先选择一个区域,然后单独从该区域发现异常。 区域-VAD在被冻结的地基模型的标志上选择一个明显的矩形,并且只从盒子内的标志上评出异常分数,通过注意力集合,然后是标准的时间头. 矩形没有被学习出来,是被冻结的指使在相接的段间变化最多的盒子,在编码器的所有四个特征预测中,它是通过对指使网格的矩形进行详尽搜索而发现的. 只有集合和时间头经过了训练,从没有盒子,口罩或帧级说明的视频级别标签,没有经过训练的组件在所选区域之外读取一个符号. 5个数据集的实验,所有数据集和主干共享一个定位器配置,显示区域-VAD在UCF-Crime和MSAD的竞争性检测性能上实现了最先进的异常定位.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Weakly supervised video anomaly detection (WS-VAD) aims to identify the frames of a video in which an anomalous event occurs, given only a video-level label for training [ 41 ] . Most methods pool each clip into a single vector and rank the clips, and when a location is needed they derive it afterwards as a map of the clip score [ 41 , 23 ] (Fig. 1 a). The location matters for two reasons. An operator needs to know where the event takes place, and a detector that shows what it attended to can be checked for whether it learned the scene or the event [ 23 , 1 ] . We address both detection and localization from video-level labels alone.
blocks.zh: 弱监督的视频异常检测(WS-VAD)旨在识别出现异常事件的视频的帧,只给培训用的视频级别标签[41]. 多数方法将每个片段集合成一个单一的向量并排列片段,当需要一个位置时,它们会从后面得到片段分数的地图[41,23](图1a). 地点之所以重要有两个原因。 操作员需要知道事件在哪里发生,显示它所出席内容的探测器可以检查它是否了解现场或事件[23,1]. 我们仅从视频级别标签中解决探测和本地化问题。

blocks.en: Spatial localization has been added to the multiple-instance learning (MIL) pipeline [ 41 , 44 , 63 ] through tube proposals [ 51 , 21 ] , vision–language alignment maps [ 55 , 54 ] , top-scoring patches [ 16 ] and learned token sparsification [ 1 ] . In all of them, the spatial output does not constrain the temporal score. The detector remains free to exploit the entire frame, and since anomalous and normal videos can often be separated by scene context alone, it can reach competitive accuracy while attending to the background [ 23 ] . Moreover, the predicted box is rarely verified as the IoU metric rewards both where a model looked and how large a box it drew, yet no published result is compared with a box of the same size at the frame centre. On XD-Violence, even a constant full-frame box is competitive. Finally, most localizers add a trained component and a dependency (proposals, detectors, prompts or a second encoder), so their localization cannot be separated from what they were trained with.
blocks.zh: 空间本地化已经通过管子建议[41,44,63],视觉-语言对齐地图[55,54],顶级评分补丁[16]和学得的标志性溅射[1],添加到多层学习(MIL)管道中. 在所有这些中,空间输出并不限制时间分数. 探测器仍然可以自由地利用整个帧,由于异常的视频和普通的视频往往可以单独通过场景背景来分离,因此在关注背景时可以达到竞争性的准确性[23]. 此外,预测的盒子很少被核实为IoU的度量奖,无论在模型外观上还是在它画的盒子大小上,都没有将公布的结果与帧中心大小相同的盒子相比较。 在XD-violence上,即使是一个恒定的全帧箱也是竞争性的. 最后,大多数本地化者都添加了经过训练的组件和依赖性(建议,探测器,提示器或第二个编码器),因此其本地化不能与他们所接受的训练分开.

blocks.en: Region-VAD reverses this order (Fig. 1 b). It first selects a region without training and then detects the anomaly from that region. When the token of a patch changes between consecutive segments, something has moved or appeared there. Region-VAD rests on two common hypotheses in the field: the region in which the frozen tokens change is the region of the event and can be found without training, and the tokens inside it carry the evidence needed to detect the event, so a detector that reads only them outperforms one that reads the whole frame. Therefore, Region-VAD leverages C-RADIOv4 [ 34 , 35 ] , which describes each frame in four projections: its own backbone’s features and those of its DINOv3, SAM 3, and SigLIP 2-aligned heads [ 40 , 3 , 46 ] . A change seen in all four is unlikely to be spurious, and highlights the region in which events are happening in the frame. Region-VAD standardizes the change map of each projection, keeps in every patch only the change that all four report, smooths the result over the neighboring segments, and selects by exhaustive search the rectangle with the largest centered sum of the resulting field. A standard temporal head then scores an attention-pooled vector of the tokens inside the rectangle. Only the pooling and the head are trained from video-level labels alone, while the localizer has no learnable parameters.
blocks.zh: 地区-VAD反转此顺序(图1b). 它首先选择一个没有经过培训的区域,然后从该区域发现异常情况。 当一个补丁的符号在连续的片段之间变化时,有些东西已经移动或出现在那里. 区域-VAD基于实地的两个常见假设: 冰冻的代币变化所在的区域是事件所在的区域,并且可以不经训练而发现,其中的代币携带了检测事件所需的证据,因此只读出这些代币的探测器超过了读取全帧的探测器. 因此,区域-VAD利用了C-RADIOv4[34,35],在四个预测中描述了每个框架: 它本身的骨干特征及其DINov3、SAM 3和SigLIP 2-对齐头[40、3、46]。 所有这四项改革都不太可能是虚假的,并突出了在框架范围内正在发生事件的区域。 区域-VAD使每个投影的改变图标准化,在每个补丁中只保留所有四个报告的变化,将结果平滑于相邻的片段上,并通过详尽的搜索来选择矩形,结果的字段中最大的中心总和. 标准时间头然后对矩形内部的符号的注意力集合矢量进行计分. 只有集合和头部单独从视频级别标签中训练,而本地化者没有可学习的参数.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose Region-VAD, a localize-then-detect architecture for WS-VAD that combines a training-free region localizer on a frozen token grid, attention pooling confined to it and a standard temporal head, trained from video-level labels only; • We introduce three controls for spatial localization against which we report every result: the size-matched centered box, the full-frame box, and a fixed box at the center of the frame; • We achieve state-of-the-art localization on UCF-Crime and MSAD, and show that a standard temporal head detects more accurately from the tokens inside the box than from the full frame on all evaluated benchmarks.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们提议区域-VAD,即WS-VAD的本地化-当时的探测架构,将无训练的区域本地化器结合在一个冷冻的标志网格上,将注意力集中到它上,以及一个标准的时间头,只从视频级别标签上培训; • 我们采用三种空间定位控制,报告每个结果:尺寸匹配的中心箱、全帧箱和框中央的固定箱; 实现UCF-Crime和MSAD的先进定位,并显示标准时间头比所有评估基准的全帧更准确地从箱内标记中检测出。

blocks.en: We propose Region-VAD, a localize-then-detect architecture for WS-VAD that combines a training-free region localizer on a frozen token grid, attention pooling confined to it and a standard temporal head, trained from video-level labels only;
blocks.zh: 我们提议区域-VAD,即WS-VAD的本地化-当时的探测架构,将无训练的区域本地化器结合在一个冷冻的标志网格上,将注意力集中到这个网格上,以及一个标准的时间头,只从视频级别标签上培训;

blocks.en: We introduce three controls for spatial localization against which we report every result: the size-matched centered box, the full-frame box, and a fixed box at the center of the frame;
blocks.zh: 我们采用三种空间定位控制,报告每个结果:尺寸匹配的中央箱、全帧箱和帧中央的固定箱;

blocks.en: We achieve state-of-the-art localization on UCF-Crime and MSAD, and show that a standard temporal head detects more accurately from the tokens inside the box than from the full frame on all evaluated benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们实现了UCF-Crime和MSAD的先进本地化,并显示标准时间头比所有评估基准的完整框架更准确地从盒子内的标志物中检测出来。

blocks.en: The dominant paradigm was introduced with UCF-Crime [ 41 ] , where clips embedded by a frozen backbone [ 45 , 4 ] are scored by a network trained with a multiple-instance ranking loss. Later work improved the scorer [ 56 , 29 , 9 ] with pseudo-labels [ 61 , 10 , 22 , 42 ] , feature-magnitude and normalcy objectives [ 44 , 58 , 5 ] , memory units [ 63 ] and vision-language backbones [ 55 , 57 , 32 , 53 ] . The benchmarks expanded to ShanghaiTech [ 24 , 61 ] , XD-Violence [ 52 ] , UBnormal [ 2 ] and MSAD [ 64 ] , and the metrics have been re-examined [ 25 ] . The tendency of the scorer to exploit context has been countered in the temporal feature space, with context-invariant features [ 26 ] , context-motion relations [ 6 ] or separate human and scene streams [ 28 ] . Training-free variants replace the scorer with a captioner and a language model [ 59 ] . All of these methods score a feature of the entire frame.
blocks.zh: 以UCF-Crime[41]引入了主导范式,其中由冷冻骨干嵌入的片段[45,4]被训练有素的网络打分,出现多层排位损失. 后来的工作改进了计分器[56,29,9],并配有伪标签[61,10,22,42],特征放大度和常态目标[44,58,5],记忆单元[63]和视觉语言主干线[55,57,32,53]. 基准扩大至上海科技[24,61],XD-暴力[52],UBONY[2]和MSAD[64],计量标准经过重新审查[25]. 计分者利用上下文的倾向在时间特征空间中得到了反驳,其上下文变化性特征[26],上下文-运动关系[6]或单独的人流和场景流[28]. 无培训变体以字幕和语言模型取代计分器 [59]. 所有这些方法都得分了整个帧的一个特征.

blocks.en: In the one-class setting, object-centric methods crop every object found by a pretrained detector and score the crops [ 15 , 12 , 11 , 47 ] . They localize by construction [ 33 ] , but only for the classes of the detector, so an anomaly of another class, or one without a distinct object, is never cropped. An open-vocabulary segmenter such as SAM 3 [ 3 ] could widen this set at the cost of a further large model. Region-VAD also localizes before scoring, but takes its region from the change of the encoder’s own tokens between consecutive segments, without a detector or training, so the region is not tied to object classes. It also learns from video-level labels instead of normal videos alone. Under weak supervision, boxes were first annotated on UCF-Crime to show that training on the local region improves detection [ 19 ] , and the annotation of its test set [ 23 ] introduced the per-frame box IoU and documented that detectors exploit the background. Later localizers obtain the box from tube proposals ranked under the MIL objective [ 51 , 21 ] , from the alignment of local features with text embeddings [ 54 , 55 ] , or from a 7 × 7 7\times 7 patch grid with a proximity-aware top- k k [ 16 ] . In each case the region is derived from a clip score computed on the full frame, and none is compared with a box of fixed size. Closest to our motivation, SST-WSVADL [ 1 ] learns to sparsify anomaly-relevant tokens under a motion-aware regularizer, releases dense boxes for UCF-Crime, XD-Violence and MSAD, and proposes the localization output as an audit of scene bias. We adopt its annotations and its auditing view, but our trained detector reads only the tokens inside the region.
blocks.zh: 在一等的设定中,以物体为中心的方法对预先训练的探测器发现的每个物体进行裁剪,并给作物打分[15,12,11,47]. 它们通过构造[33]本地化,但只针对探测器的等级,所以另一个等级的异常,或者一个没有明显物体的异常,从不裁剪. 如SAM 3[3]等开放的省道机可以扩大这一套,而代价是再增加一个大型模型。 区域-VAD在评分前也会本地化,但从编码器本身的符号在连续段间的变化中取出区域,没有探测器或训练,因此区域没有与对象课挂钩. 它还从视频级别的标签中学习,而不是仅仅从普通的视频中学习. 在薄弱的监管下,首次对UCF-Crime进行了注解,以表明关于当地地区的培训改进了检测[19],对其测试集的注释[23]引入了每帧框IoU,并记录了探测器利用背景的情况. 后期本地化者通过在MIL目标下排名的管式建议[51,21],通过将本地特征与文本嵌入[54,55]对齐,或者从一个7×7 7\时的补丁网格中获取该盒,并带有近距离知觉的顶级-k k [16]. 在每一种情况下,区域都是从一个按全帧计算的剪辑分数中得出的,没有一个比不上固定大小的盒子。 与我们的动机最接近的是,SST-WSVADL [1] 学会在运动感应常态器下将异常相关符号溅射,为UCF-Crime,XD-violence和MSAD释放密集的盒,并提出本地化输出作为对场景偏差的审计. 我们采纳其说明和审计观点,但我们训练有素的探测器只读区域内的标志。

blocks.en: Selecting a region and pooling inside it can be seen as multiple-instance learning with spatial instances [ 14 ] . Class activation maps [ 62 , 37 ] instead derive the region from a classifier after it has scored the image. Training-free localization from frozen tokens exists for single images, from a seed patch [ 38 ] , a normalized cut of the patch graph [ 50 , 30 , 49 ] or the attention of the background [ 39 ] , and motion has been used as an unsupervised cue for segmentation [ 7 ] . Our field instead measures the change of the tokens over time. Our tokens come from frozen foundation encoders, DINOv3 [ 31 , 40 ] , SAM [ 17 , 36 , 3 ] and SigLIP 2 [ 46 ] , distilled by C-RADIOv4 [ 34 , 13 , 35 ] into one student that exposes a projection into each teacher’s space. Motion has long served as a localization cue in anomaly detection, from flow-based models [ 27 , 24 ] to the motion-aware regularizer of [ 1 ] , and temporal differencing in feature space serves action recognition [ 48 ] . Our change field is computed from the encoder’s own tokens in four projections at once, has no learned weight and selects the region itself, whereas [ 1 ] uses motion to regularize a trained selector.

blocks.en: Region-VAD consists of three stages (Fig. 2 ). A frozen encoder maps every segment of a video to a grid of tokens in four projections (Sec. 3.1 ). A training-free rule then selects one rectangle R t R_{t} per segment from these tokens alone (Sec. 3.2 ). Finally, only the tokens inside R t R_{t} are pooled and scored by a standard temporal head. This last stage is the only trained one and learns from video-level labels (Sec. 3.3 ).

blocks.en: C-RADIOv4 is released with the feature-projection heads of its distillation, which map the backbone tokens into the patch-feature space of each teacher. Applied to every encoded frame, they yield three further grids of the same layout: DINOv3 (4096-d), SAM 3 (1024-d) and SigLIP 2 (1536-d). The DINOv3 and SAM 3 heads are per-token perceptrons, whereas the SigLIP 2 head prepends two self-attention blocks, so its projection also depends on the rest of the frame. The heads are also frozen. We refer to the token of patch p ∈ P p\in P in segment t t under projection k ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } k\in\{1,2,3,4\} as x t , p k ∈ ℝ d k x^{k}_{t,p}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{k}} , with k = 1 k=1 the backbone and k = 2 , 3 , 4 k=2,3,4 the DINOv3, SAM 3 and SigLIP 2 heads respectively.

The four grids describe the same pixels in feature spaces shaped by different objectives and differ in granularity. DINOv3 and the backbone group the frame into a few smooth regions, while SAM 3 and SigLIP 2 vary almost token by token. They differ accordingly in how they measure change from one segment to the next (Fig. 3 ). The maps agree on the moving object but peak in different patches, and each reports changes that the others do not confirm.
blocks.zh: 四个网格描述不同目标塑造的特征空间中相同的像素,颗粒性也有所不同. DINOv3和骨干将框架组合成几个平滑的区域,而SAM 3和SigLIP 2则几乎以符号来变化. 因此,它们如何衡量从一个部分到另一个部分的变动情况有所不同(图3)。 地图上对移动对象一致,但在不同补丁中达到峰值,每份报告都会改变,而其他报告并不确认.

blocks.en: Where a token of the grid differs from the previous segment, something has moved or appeared, and such change is a cue for anomalous events that unfold over time. A video-level label does not say where to look, since every location in an anomalous video is equally consistent with it. We therefore compute the region from the frozen tokens with no learnable parameter (Fig. 2 , \raisebox{-0.6pt}{\scriptsize2}⃝ ), so the localization of Region-VAD depends only on the tokens of the frozen encoder.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We conduct our experiments on five WS-VAD benchmarks. UCF-Crime [ 41 ] and XD-Violence [ 52 ] are the two most widely used real-world datasets, the latter with camera motion. MSAD [ 64 ] is a recent multi-scenario dataset, UBnormal [ 2 ] is synthetic with pixel-level masks for every anomaly, and ShanghaiTech [ 24 ] , in its weakly supervised split [ 61 ] , is recorded by fixed campus cameras. We evaluate localization on every public spatial annotation, namely the boxes of [ 23 ] on every 16th UCF-Crime frame, following [ 16 ] , the dense per-frame boxes of [ 1 ] on UCF-Crime, MSAD and XD-Violence, and the boxes of the official pixel masks of UBnormal and ShanghaiTech. Table 1 reports the size of the annotated boxes and of ours; Section B of the appendix gives the full statistics of the annotated boxes.
blocks.zh: 我们在五个WS-VAD基准上进行实验. UCF-Crime [41] 和XD-Vilence [52]是两个使用最广泛的现实世界数据集,后者带有相机运动. MSAD [64] 是一款近代的多场景数据集,UBormal [2] 在每个异常点都用像素级口罩合成,而上海科技 [24] 在其弱监督的分裂 [61] 中,由固定校区摄像头录制. 我们评价每个公共空间注释的本地化,即继[16]之后,每16个UCF-犯罪框架的[23]个盒子,UCF-犯罪、MSAD和XD-暴力的[1]个框的密集度,以及Ubority和上海科技的官方像素面具的盒子。 表1报告了注解框和我们注解框的大小;附录B节提供了注解框的全部统计数据。

blocks.en: Detection is measured by frame-level AUC, and frame-level AP on XD-Violence, following the established protocol [ 52 ] , with the score of a segment assigned to its 16 frames. Localization is measured by TIoU, the IoU between the predicted and the annotated box averaged over all annotated anomalous test frames, as defined in [ 16 ] and reported as MIoU in [ 1 ] . TIoU ignores the detection score of these frames and does not count false alarms on normal video, which AUC and AP measure.
blocks.zh: 检测通过帧级的AUC和帧级的关于XD-暴力的AP来测量,遵循既定的协议[52],其16帧的分数分配为一段. 本地化由TIoU进行测量,IoU在预测和附加说明的框之间平均测量所有附加说明的异常测试框架,定义为[16],在[1]中报告为MIoU. TIoU忽略了这些帧的检测分数,在普通视频中不计假警报,AUC和AP测量.

blocks.en: Since TIoU credits a box both for where it is placed and for how large it is, every localization result of Region-VAD is reported next to three controls. The centred box is a rectangle of the same size as R t R_{t} placed at the centre of the frame, so a gain over it comes from placement. The TIoU of the full-frame box is the area fraction of the annotated boxes, and a fixed box of 8 × 8 8{\times}8 patches at the centre of the frame depends on no method. On XD-Violence the annotated boxes are large and central (Table 1 ) and the full frame alone is the second-best localizer of Table 2 . The fixed box still scores above several published localizers on the boxes of [ 23 ] and above two on ShanghaiTech. A fourth control, the frame-difference box, applies the same region selection to pixel frame differencing, averaged over the 16 frames of the segment and pooled to the same 20 × 15 20\times 15 grid, to measure what the encoder’s tokens add. Every detection result is compared with the full-frame feature , the same head trained on the mean of the backbone tokens of the whole frame as in the conventional order of Fig. 1 a, and with the same head trained on the mean of the tokens inside each of the three other boxes. For these boxes, we report the best of the four projections on each dataset.
blocks.zh: 由于TIoU为它的位置和大小都记入了一个盒子,因此区域-VAD的每个本地化结果都报告在三个控制器旁边. 中心箱是一个与Rt RQQT}一样大小的矩形,放置在帧中心,因此对它的一个收益来自于放置. 全框框的TIoU是注解框的面积分数,框中央一个8×8 8×Times}8补丁的固定框则取决于任何方法. 在XD-暴力方面,附加说明的方框是大和中央的(表1),仅整个框架就是表2的第二佳本地化者。 固定箱在上海科技网的[23]个和2个以上的箱上,仍得分高于数个已公布的本地化器. 第四个控件,帧-偏差框,对像素帧的不同应用相同的区域选择,平均在段的16帧上,集合到相同的20×15 20\times 15网格,以测量编码器的符号添加了什么. 每个检测结果都与全帧特征作比较,同一头像图1 a的常规顺序一样在全帧主骨标志的平均值上训练,而同一头像在其他三个盒子内每个盒子内都训练的平均值. 对于这些框,我们报告每个数据集四个预测中最好的一个。

blocks.en: The pooling stages and the head are trained jointly with AdamW for 1,000 steps on batches of four anomalous and four normal videos. Every detection number is the mean over three training seeds, and Section A of the appendix gives the complete settings and the spread over seeds. On one A100, a 16-frame segment takes 14.9 ms end to end.
blocks.zh: 集合阶段和头部与亚当W联合训练,共1000步,分批训练4个反常和4个普通视频. 每个检测号是3个以上训练种子的平均值,附录A节给出了完整的设置和在种子上的分布. 在一个A100上,一个16帧机段需要14.9毫秒的终点.

blocks.en: 4.2 State-of-the-art comparison
blocks.zh: 4.2 最新比较

blocks.en: We compare Region-VAD with every published localizer on the five benchmarks in Table 2 . Region-VAD sets a new state of the art on UCF-Crime and MSAD. On the boxes of [ 23 ] it surpasses the previous best, Patch-MIL [ 16 ] , by 5.20 TIoU. On the dense annotations of [ 1 ] it is 12.55 and 6.89 TIoU above the trained localizer of SST-WSVADL [ 1 ] on UCF-Crime and MSAD. On UBnormal, we report the first result on the official masks. These margins hold against the three box controls (last rows of Table 2 ). On UCF-Crime, MSAD and UBnormal, the size-matched centred box and the fixed box score far lower, so the gain comes from where R t R_{t} is placed, which supports the first hypothesis of Sec. 1 . With pixel differences instead of tokens, the same rule localizes above every trained localizer on every dataset except XD-Violence, so the rule accounts for most of the localization. The token change is ahead on the dense boxes of UCF-Crime and MSAD and under the camera motion of XD-Violence, where frame differencing falls below the centred box, while frame differencing is ahead on the fixed cameras of UBnormal and ShanghaiTech and on the sparse frames of [ 23 ] . The token change reuses the encoder pass that detection requires. On XD-Violence, where the event fills most of the frame and the camera follows it (Table 1 ), the full-frame box beats our rectangle and every published localizer but one, and Region-VAD stays above its centred control. On ShanghaiTech, the annotated events are far smaller than R t R_{t} (Table 1 ), which has no size prior, and Region-VAD remains 0.6 points below Patch-MIL and above its centred control. Per class (Fig. 4 ), R t R_{t} beats the three box controls in every UCF-Crime class but Burglary, and the frame-difference box is ahead of R t R_{t} in about half of them. In Fig. 5 , R t R_{t} misses the annotated box entirely on 1.1–7.8% of the annotated frames. On every set but XD-Violence, it has a lower share of frames below 0.3 and 0.6 IoU than any of the three box controls, and the frame-difference box misses the annotated box less often than R t R_{t} .

blocks.en: In detection, Region-VAD is competitive with the localizing methods of Table 2 , whose detectors score the full frame. On UCF-Crime its AUC is the highest of the table, above SST-WSVADL [ 1 ] and STPrompt [ 54 ] . It is below SST-WSVADL with VideoMAE v2 on MSAD and below VadCLIP [ 55 ] and both SST-WSVADL models on XD-Violence. These methods also differ from Region-VAD in backbone and head, so the effect of reading the full frame is measured with the controls. Against the full-frame feature of the same encoder and head, the region improves detection on all five benchmarks (row Δ \Delta Full frame of Table 2 ), although on ShanghaiTech the gain is within the spread over seeds (Table S1 of the appendix). The size-matched centred box stays below the region on all five benchmarks, with the learned pooling as well as with the mean of the same rectangle, so the detection gain also comes from where the box is placed. The fixed box and the frame-difference box are also below the region on all datasets with the learned pooling. This supports the second hypothesis of Sec. 1 , that the tokens inside the rectangle carry the evidence needed to detect the anomaly.
blocks.zh: 在检测中,区域-VAD与表2的定位方法具有竞争力,其检测器得分为全帧. 在UCF-Crime上,其AUC是表中最高的,高于SST-WSVADL [1]和STPrompt [54]. 它位于SST-WSVADL以下,在MSAD上拥有VideoMAE v2,在VadCLIP [55]以下,在XD-暴力上拥有SST-WSVADL两个模型. 这些方法在骨干和头部也与区域-VAD不同,因此读取全帧的效果是用控制来测量的. 对照同一编码器和头部的全帧特征,该区域改进了所有五个基准(表2的X-\Delta全帧)的检测工作,不过在上海Tech上,收益是在种子的分布范围内(附录表S1)。 大小匹配的中框在所有五个基准上都停留在区域以下,有学得的集合以及同一矩的平均值,因此检测收益也来自盒子的位置. 固定框和帧偏移框也位于区域以下,位于所有数据集上,并有学习的集合. 这支持 Sec. 1 的第二个假设,即矩形内部的符号携带了检测异常点所需的证据.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , the temporal smoothing adds 1.5 and 2.3 TIoU on the two annotation sets. The consensus of the four maps matches the best single map, DINOv3, and is behind frame differencing on the boxes of [ 23 ] , UBnormal and ShanghaiTech (Table 2 ). On UCF-Crime the consensus brings no gain in accuracy, but it combines the four maps instead of selecting one, a choice that would require box annotations.
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,时间平滑在两套注释中增加了1.5和2.3个TIoU。 四张地图的共识与最佳的单张地图DINOv3相匹配,并在框后在[23],UBNormal和上海Tech(表2)的框上出现差异. 在UCF-Crime上,共识没有带来准确性的好处,但它结合了四张地图而不是选择一张,这个选择需要框注.

blocks.en: Table 4 ablates the two pooling stages on UCF-Crime with C-RADIOv4. With UR-DMU, mean pooling inside R t R_{t} improves on the full-frame mean for every projection, by up to 2.5 AUC, and attention over the patches adds to the mean for the backbone and SigLIP 2 projections. The attention over the four maps of Region-VAD gains most from the learned pooling, 1.7 AUC over the mean of the same region. It exceeds the best single map, SigLIP 2, by 1.0 AUC, less than the spread of Region-VAD over seeds (Table S1 of the appendix), and weights the four maps instead of selecting one. Under the ranking loss of the MLP head the pooling matters less, and the region improves on the full-frame mean for only two of the four projections.

On both annotation sets V-JEPA 2.1, SAM 2 and RADIO v2.5 localize above the previous state of the art, Patch-MIL [ 16 ] and SST-WSVADL [ 1 ] (Table 2 ), and VideoMAE v2 and InternVideo2 do so on the dense boxes. The consensus of C-RADIOv4 matches its DINOv3 map in TIoU and gives the highest AUC. Section A of the appendix gives the token grid of each encoder.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented Region-VAD, a localize-then-detect approach to WS-VAD. A training-free rule selects the rectangle where the tokens of a frozen encoder change most, and a learned pooling and a standard temporal head detect from the tokens inside it. Region-VAD sets a new state of the art in localization on UCF-Crime and MSAD and detects more accurately from inside the rectangle than from the full frame on all five benchmarks. Future work includes a single detector for the five benchmarks and a size prior that transfers across datasets, for events that fill or barely occupy the frame.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了地区-VAD,即WS-VAD的本地化和当时的检测方法。 无训练规则选择一个冷冻编码器的符号变化最多的矩形,一个学习的集合和一个标准的时间头从里面的符号中检测到. 地区-VAD为UCF-Crime和SMAD的本地化设定了新的技术,并且从矩形内部比从所有五个基准的全框架更准确地检测。 今后的工作包括一个单一的探测器,用于五个基准,以及跨数据集传输之前的大小,用于填充或勉强占用框架的事件。

blocks.en: The rule assumes that the event is where the frozen tokens change most. Dominant normal motion, such as traffic, can pull the rectangle away from an event elsewhere. A stationary or slow anomaly changes the tokens little, and one rectangle cannot enclose two distant events without the space between them. One middle frame per 16-frame segment can miss a brief event and does not represent motion inside a segment. In anomalous training videos a misplaced rectangle gives the pooling noisy input. Context outside the rectangle, such as signs or lane markings, reaches the detector only through the frozen tokens inside it.
blocks.zh: 规则假设该事件是被冻结的象征物变化最大的地方. 交通等占主导地位的正常运动可以拉动矩形远离其他地方的事件. 静态或慢态异常会改变符号的微小,一个矩形无法将两个遥远的事件夹在它们之间的空间. 每16帧片段有一个中间框可以错过一个短暂的事件,并不代表片段内部的运动. 在反常的训练视频中,一个错位的矩形会给集合的噪音输入. 矩形外的上下文,如标志或车道标志,只能通过其中的冷冻标志到达探测器.

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation details
blocks.zh: 附录A 实施情况

blocks.en: Videos are divided into non-overlapping segments of 16 frames. The middle frame of each segment is resized to 320 × 240 320\times 240 pixels and encoded once by the frozen C-RADIOv4-SO400M [ 35 ] (Sec. 3.1 ), with a patch size of 16, which yields a 20 × 15 20\times 15 grid of tokens for the backbone and for each of its DINOv3, SAM 3 and SigLIP 2 projections. The region R t R_{t} is computed once from these tokens with the rule of Sec. 3.2 and stored as a set of patches; it is mapped to pixels through the patch grid and reported for every frame of its segment. No part of the localizer is trained or tuned per dataset.
blocks.zh: 视频分为16帧的非重叠片段. 每个段的中间框被调整为320×240 320\时的240像素,并被冰冻的C-RADIOv4-SO400M[35](Sec. 3.1])编码一次,补丁尺寸为16,它为骨干和它的DINov3,SAM 3和SigLIP 2的预测,产生20×15 20\时的15个格令牌. R t R_{t} 区域是用 sec. 3.2 的规则从这些符号中计算一次,并作为一组补丁存储;它通过补丁网格被映射成像素,并报告其片段的每个帧. 每个数据集都不培训或调制本地化器的任何部分。

blocks.en: Each projection is brought to d = 512 d=512 dimensions by its own layer normalization and linear layer. Both attention probes of Sec. 3.3 use H = 8 H=8 heads, a single learned query and an MLP with one hidden layer of width 4 ​ d 4d and GELU activation. The pooled feature is fed to the head’s own input layer, a linear layer followed by layer normalization. UR-DMU [ 63 ] keeps its published architecture, losses and loss weights. The ablation of Table 4 also uses the multilayer perceptron of [ 41 ] as a lighter head on the ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized pooled feature. It is trained with its ranking hinge between the highest score of an anomalous and of a normal video and with its temporal smoothness and sparsity terms at their published weights.
blocks.zh: 每个投影通过自己的层常态和线性层,被带至d=512 d=512维. Sec.3.3的注意力探测器都使用H = 8 H = 8 头,一个单一的学习查询和一个有一层宽度为4d 4d的隐藏层的MLP和GELU激活. 集合功能被输入到头部的输入层,一个线性层,然后是层的正常化. UR-DMU [63] 保留其出版的建筑,损耗和减重. 表4的缩写还使用[41]的多层感官作为l 2\ell\2} - 正常集合特征上的更轻头. 它的排名取决于异常和正常视频的最高得分,以及其公布的重量的时空平滑度和痉挛度。

blocks.en: The pooling stages and the head are trained jointly with AdamW (learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 2 10^{-2} , warm-up followed by cosine decay) for 1,000 steps on batches of four anomalous and four normal videos, each with all its segments, without early stopping or checkpoint selection.

blocks.en: In Table S3 , we replace the token change of Sec. 3.2 by motion on UCF-Crime and keep the rest of the rule unchanged. Pixel frame differencing, the frame-difference control of Table 2 , localizes on par with Region-VAD, while the magnitude of RAFT optical flow [ 43 ] is about 20 TIoU lower, with or without the median flow removed.
blocks.zh: 在表S3中,我们用关于UCF-Crime的动议取代了第3.2司的象征性改动,并保持其余规则不变。 像素帧不同,表2的帧偏差控制,与Region-VAD对等本地化,而RAFT光学流的大小[43]则低约20 TIoU,无论是否去掉中位流.

blocks.en: Table S2 : Size of the annotated boxes. Area of the ground-truth box as a percentage of the frame over the annotated anomalous test frames: mean, median, interquartile range, and the share of frames whose box exceeds half the frame or is below 5% of it.
blocks.zh: 表S2:注解框的大小。 地面真人盒面积占框架比例高于附加说明的异常试验框架:平均值、中值、方位范围,以及盒内超过框架一半或低于5%的帧份额。

blocks.en: Table S3 : Region selection from motion and from tokens on UCF-Crime. TIoU of the rectangle selected by the rule of Sec. 3.2 , with the same temporal smoothing, from pixel frame differencing, from RAFT-large optical-flow magnitude over the 16 frame pairs of each segment, each frame with its predecessor (raw, and with the per-pair median flow removed at a cost negligible next to RAFT), and from the consensus of the four projections (Region-VAD). FPS counts video frames per second of the whole pipeline, encoder and detection head included, on one NVIDIA L4 with segments processed one at a time and video decoding excluded. On an A100, Region-VAD runs at 1,076 FPS (Sec. 4.1 ). Bold/underline: best/second-best per column.
blocks.zh: 表S3:从UCF-Crime上的动议和信物中挑选的区域。 Sec. 3.2规则所选择的矩形的TIoU,具有相同的时间平滑,从像素框架差异,从每个段的16个框架对上的RAFT-大光学流量,每个框架与它的前身(raw,以及每段中位流去除,成本在RAFT旁边可忽略不计),从四个预测的共识(Region-VAD). FPS将整个管道每秒的视频帧、编码器和检测头计算在内,在一个NVIDIA L4上,一次处理一个片段,并排除视频解码。 在A100上,地区-VAD运行的频率为1,076FPS(Sec.4.1)。 粗体/底线:每列最优/次优.

blocks.en: Table S2 gives the size of the ground-truth boxes of every annotation set of Sec. 4.1 , as a fraction of the frame, and completes Table 1 with the interquartile range and the two tails. A box covering the full frame obtains a TIoU close to the mean box area (Table 2 ). On XD-Violence three quarters of the annotated frames have a box larger than half the frame, so the full-frame box beats R t R_{t} and every published localizer but one (Sec. 4.2 ). ShanghaiTech is the opposite case, with a median box below 2% of the frame. Figure S1 repeats the per-class analysis of Fig. 4 on the boxes of [ 23 ] .
